verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships a built-in `crewai test` CLI command that runs a crew for a set number of iterations and reports detailed performance metrics, so its own eval capability exists. The evidence does not document how quality is scored or graded, and does not show CI integration. Running the CLI in CI is implied, not documented. Missing for 10: documented scoring criteria and quality metrics, CI integration guidance (exit codes, thresholds, pipeline examples), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can score agent quality with built-in evals and run them as part of CI

citations.quote: We added the CLI command `crewai test` to make it easy to test your crew. This command will run your crew for a specified number of iterations and provide detailed performance metrics.
Monitor, evaluate, and optimize your CrewAI agents with comprehensive observability tools
